consent.headerDescription: Before we get started, we need your explicit consent to store and process health and care data for your elderly relative, as required by the Digital Personal Data Protection Act 2023 (DPDP Act).

health.title: Health & care information
health.detail: Medical notes, mobility status, and wellness observations about your elderly relative.

bookings.title: Booking & service history
bookings.detail: Records of care visits, services booked, and payments made through ElderLink.

location.title: Location data (during visits)
location.detail: Live GPS location shared by the caregiver during an active booking — visible only to you.

profile.title: Phone number & profile
profile.detail: Your contact details to enable booking, notifications, and account management.

assurances.localisation: Data is stored in India (Mumbai region) in compliance with DPDP localisation requirements.
assurances.noSale: Data is never sold to third parties. It is used solely to provide ElderLink services.
assurances.erasure: You can request erasure of your data at any time from your account settings.

consent.footerNote: By continuing, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and agree to ElderLink's data processing as described above.

jobReport.title: Visit report
jobReport.subtitle: Takes about 2 minutes — fill it while the visit is fresh.

summary.question: What did you do during the visit?
summary.placeholder: e.g. Accompanied Mr. Sharma on a 30-minute walk around the park. He was in good spirits and chatted about his grandchildren. Helped him with his afternoon medication.
summary.hint: The family reads this — write as if you're speaking to them directly.

vitals.question: Any health observations?
vitals.placeholder: e.g. Seemed a bit short of breath on the walk. Said knee pain was better than last week.

followUp.question: Should the family follow up on anything?
followUp.notesQuestion: What should the family follow up on?
followUp.notesPlaceholder: e.g. Mentioned chest discomfort earlier in the day. May need a doctor's visit.
